edited_fraction: unclear (whole network in the write-from-zero experiment; edit sizes not reported as a fraction)
cost_reported: Writing a network: 8.50-9.08 USD (Opus) and 38-39 min wall-clock vs 2-5 s of A100 gradient training
evidence_notes: LLM reading, editing and writing of EEG/ECG classifiers is the whole study (p.1-2). Except for reading (exp. 1, weights as text, no tools), edits and writing go through a persistent sandboxed Python session holding the tensors, with and without evaluate/pass feedback (p.4), so code_or_tensor_tool and both protocols; DeepSeek matched Opus on EEG repair (Table III, p.6), so open-weight did not clearly fail. Success rules were 'fixed in advance' (p.2, p.7) but no registry, timestamp or hash is given, so prereg is coded none; gpt-oss-120b grades all textual answers and Claude helped with figures and consistency checks (p.8). Prompts and reasoning traces are on a project website (p.2) but no code release link is given.
